name: Oku reading app social card by oku.club
description: A monochrome ink-on-paper social card built on an asymmetric split: a small serif lockup and a two-line serif headline (~72–80px) anchor the left half, while a grainy hand-inked illustration of a lounging reader and an open book bleeds off the right edge. Only two values are used — warm off-white paper and near-black ink — and there is no chrome, gradient or footer, so the card reads like a page from a book and stays legible at chat-preview thumbnail sizes.
